about: Sound effects synthesized in code by Focus AI Academy. 48 kHz. Used by scripts/mix.mjs.
fields: preroll: seconds from the start of the file to the moment that lands on the cue. level: the gain that puts the sound at its place in the mix. field: centre (stays in the middle), side (alternates right and left at pan), sweep (moves across the field; every second use is mirrored; to = the side where the motion in the file ends). mirror: a ready mirrored copy of the file.

hit.what: a short punch: a crack over a low thump

impact.what: a big deep boom with a long tail

whoosh.what: a rush of air that peaks on the cue

click.what: a double click, like a mouse button

rise.what: a riser that climbs into the cue and stops on it

sub.what: a low bass drop, felt more than heard
